purpose: Fixture binding notes only; this is not an application file format or a JSON schema.
record_status: K2 format-1 record example bound against CamWight PR3891 source; no application/runtime acceptance claimed. The future harness reconciles format_pending with its pinned writer.

logical_ids.source_a: The plate source record; one owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.source_b: The block source record; distinct from source_a and reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.sheet_a: The plate sheet; distinct owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.
logical_ids.sheet_b: The block sheet; distinct owner-allocated ID reused in C0 and C1.

writer_owned.format_pending: Read DRAWING.pending_names from the pinned implementation; omitted here for the published format-1 example. Never invent a pending-change name.
writer_owned.container: K3 container APIs and canonical archive encoding are not implemented by this contribution.
writer_owned.runtime_readers: Bind dependency/source/session operations to their owners actual APIs.

source_root_component: Existing native fixture documents use root component 0. Bind that identity through the agreed Drawing representation; do not guess a new globally unique ID or rewrite the source.
not_decided_here: Repository resolution API and historical materialization
id_rule: 13 lowercase Crockford base32 characters encoding a nonzero u64, unique across every drawing object. Fixed sample IDs model retained random identities; they are not a stored counter.

confirmed_fields.documents: {source: drawing source ID, component: native design component number; root=0}
